name: Puducherry
tagline: A French legacy in the heart of India

topAttractions.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
topAttractions.description: A beautiful Catholic church built in 1894, showcasing a mix of French and Indian architectural styles

topAttractions.name: Pondicherry Museum
topAttractions.description: A museum showcasing the history and culture of Puducherry, with a collection of artifacts and exhibits on the region's French and Indian heritage

topAttractions.name: Auroville
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO-recognized experimental township that aims to create a self-sufficient community, promoting peace, harmony, and sustainability

bestTimeToVisit: October to February, when the weather is cool and pleasant, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities
culturalFact: Puducherry is home to the famous Pondicherry Handloom Weaves, a Geographical Indication (GI)-tagged craft that showcases the region's expertise in weaving and textile production

hiddenGem.name: The Promenade Beach
hiddenGem.description: A scenic beach along the Bay of Bengal, perfect for sunset views and a relaxing stroll

relatedFestival: The Puducherry Republic Day Celebrations, held on January 26th, which marks the anniversary of India's independence and the French legacy in the region
passportTieIn: If you have a stamp from Auroville or a wish to visit the Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, Puducherry is the perfect destination to fulfill your travel dreams!
